test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a key focus area of the PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Multi-modal connectivity**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan** is a transformative initiative by the Government of India aimed at improving **infrastructure planning and implementation.**
 
• The focus is on **multi-modal connectivity**, which integrates various modes of transport—such as roadways, railways, waterways, and airways—to ensure seamless movement of goods and people.
 
• This plan aims to reduce **logistics costs**, enhance supply chain efficiency, and boost **economic growth.**
 
• It leverages **geospatial technology** and digital tools to create a unified platform for better coordination among ministries and state governments.
 
• The initiative also seeks to address issues like **delayed infrastructure projects** and overlapping efforts by different departments.
 
• By ensuring synchronized development, the plan contributes to improving the **global competitiveness of Indian industries.**
 
• The target sectors include **transportation, energy, manufacturing, and urban development.**
 
• The PM Gati Shakti framework aligns with India's **vision of becoming a $5 trillion economy** by enhancing connectivity and infrastructure development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rural electrification**__

 __
 
• **Rural electrification** is a critical initiative to provide electricity access to rural households and villages.
 
• India has implemented programs such as **Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana** to improve electricity distribution in rural areas.
 
• While important for development, it is not the focus area of the **PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan**.
 
 
 
• **Agricultural subsidies**__
 __
 
• **Agricultural subsidies** are financial aids provided by governments to support farmers and agriculture-related activities.
 
• These subsidies aim to reduce input costs and enhance productivity in farming.
 
• However, they are not directly related to **multi-modal connectivity**, which is the key focus of the PM Gati Shakti initiative.
 
 
 
• **Urban development**__
 
 
• **Urban development** focuses on improving infrastructure, housing, and services within cities and towns.
 
• Although urban development is a significant area, the **PM Gati Shakti** plan has a broader scope that includes multi-modal connectivity across both urban and rural areas.
